In addition to the normal text, dynamic variables are also available, like Date, Data usage and Temperature:

$G\<format\> : Gregorian date, based on format*
$P<format> : Persian date, based on format*
$Nrx : Total Downloads in specified period ** ***
$Ntx: Total Uploads in specified period ** ***
$Nall : Total Traffic in specified period ** ***
$Nssid : WiFi SSID name (if applicable)

$T\<format\>[interval] : Temperature; 
format can be b (for battery), c (for CPU), g (for GPU) and s (for skin) 
Lastly, there is OPTIONAL number of update interval in seconds (default: 60 seconds)

*for format documentation, search for "Java Date Format"
**You can specify the statistics period in PixelXpert-Next/Miscellaneous menu/Network Statistics Settings
***If you replace $N with $Nc you will get with mobile data statistics (e.g. $Ncrx instead of Nrx)
